meta.title: Tajo Pages | Comics born in Toledo
meta.description: Tajo Pages is a comic book brand born in Toledo. Incredible adventures, told page by page.

contacto.texto: One single contact email address for everything: collaboration proposals, press and any question about Tajo Pages. It is answered from there.

comics.texto: This is where Tajo Pages comics will appear, each one with its cover, its synopsis and where to read it. None is published yet: Tajo Pages has only just started.
comics.portada: Cover of TOLETUM No. 1: Celestial Invader

p1.texto: Tajo Pages is a Spanish comic book brand born in September 2026.

p2.texto: Its stories are grouped into sagas. The first one is called TOLETUM.

p3.texto: TOLETUM is only the beginning: many more sagas will arrive over time.

p1.texto: The Tajo, known in English as the Tagus, surrounds Toledo on three sides and has been part of the city's image for centuries.

p2.texto: In Spanish, a tajo is also a sword cut. And Toledo has been famous for its swords for centuries.

p3.texto: Pages, because every story is told page by page. And because its home on the internet is tajo.page.

p1.texto: Anyone who draws, writes, colours or letters comics and wants to tell stories with Tajo Pages.

p2.texto: Who you are, what you do and links to work you have already published. That is enough to start talking.

p3.texto: Send an email to the address shown below, with the subject “Tajo Pages collaboration”. No forms and no middlemen.

lector.teclado: Turn the page with the arrow keys

celestial-invader.001: Toletum, 13th century. The city sleeps behind its walls.
celestial-invader.002: On the wall, old Mateo the watchman keeps his watch.
celestial-invader.004: It was no star. It was fire falling from the sky.
celestial-invader.005: A deep rumble rattles the shutters across half the city.
celestial-invader.006: At the Tajo inn, Hernán de Castilla wakes with a start.
celestial-invader.007: It is heading straight for the heart of the city!
celestial-invader.009: The blast knocks down stalls, carts and chimneys.
celestial-invader.010: Where the market stood, there is now a crater.
celestial-invader.011: While everyone flees, one man walks toward the danger.
celestial-invader.012: Captain Rodrigo and his guard surround the crater.
celestial-invader.013: “What has fallen here, Rodrigo?” “Nothing good, Hernán.”
celestial-invader.014: The stone from the sky is still burning inside.
celestial-invader.016: Inside the stone there is an egg. A huge egg.
celestial-invader.018: Friar Anselmo calls for calm; others want to smash it with their axes.
celestial-invader.019: “Let no one come near until dawn!”
celestial-invader.020: The shell is as hot as a stone baking in the sun.
celestial-invader.021: Thump... thump... thump... Something is beating inside.
celestial-invader.022: The night passes. No one watches what they should.
celestial-invader.024: SSSSS! The iron melts like wax.
celestial-invader.027: Out of the egg comes something that does not belong to this world.
celestial-invader.028: It smells of brimstone and rot.
celestial-invader.032: It is as quick as a lizard.
celestial-invader.033: And it slips away where no one can follow.
celestial-invader.035: “Search every corner of Toletum for it!”
celestial-invader.036: In the Jewish quarter, Sara the baker hears noises below.
celestial-invader.037: “A demon! There is a demon in my house!”
celestial-invader.038: It has eaten all the bread... and shed its skin.
celestial-invader.039: “In one night it has doubled in size.”
celestial-invader.040: That afternoon, the cats of the quarter disappear.
celestial-invader.043: ...animals were no longer enough for it.
celestial-invader.044: “By order of the council, let no one go out after nightfall!”
celestial-invader.045: Hernán has no intention of staying indoors.
celestial-invader.046: “Always at night. Always near the sewers.”
celestial-invader.047: The caves and cisterns beneath Toletum are a labyrinth.
celestial-invader.052: By a hair's breadth. Luckily, it has not yet mastered its fire.
celestial-invader.053: CLANG! Its skin is already as hard as iron.
celestial-invader.054: And once again it gets away.
celestial-invader.055: It has come out in the middle of the market!
celestial-invader.056: The arrows do not even tickle it.
celestial-invader.057: It leaps from rooftop to rooftop.
celestial-invader.058: Hernán follows it on the back of Lucero.
celestial-invader.059: On the slope up to the Alcázar, a little girl has been left alone.
celestial-invader.061: The shield did not survive. The girl did.
celestial-invader.063: The beast hears that name... and does not forget it.
celestial-invader.065: Days go by. The beast does not stop eating or growing.
celestial-invader.066: One morning, its wings grow all at once.
celestial-invader.067: And at last it masters its fire.
celestial-invader.069: It is no longer a creature. It is a dragon.
celestial-invader.070: Its shadow darkens the whole city.
celestial-invader.073: The townspeople carry water up from the Tajo bucket by bucket.
celestial-invader.074: Where the water touches its scales, a white smoke rises.
celestial-invader.076: “If we do not stop it, not one stone will be left standing.”
celestial-invader.077: They make ready the great crossbow of the Alcázar.
celestial-invader.079: It snaps like a dry branch.
celestial-invader.083: Toletum has fallen into the claws of the dragon.
celestial-invader.084: “Everything that lives has a weak spot.”
celestial-invader.085: Hernán remembers the tunnels: the beast jumped over the puddles.
celestial-invader.086: It never crossed the bridge. It never went near the river.
celestial-invader.087: And it pulled away from the water falling from a roof.
celestial-invader.088: “We have to make sure of it.”
celestial-invader.089: There is only one way to find out.
celestial-invader.091: SSSSSHHH! The scales crack like dry mud.
celestial-invader.093: “Water burns it, Rodrigo. But it takes a lot of water.”
celestial-invader.094: “And how do you put a dragon into the Tajo?”
celestial-invader.095: “We do not put it in. We bring the Tajo to it.”
celestial-invader.096: The mill of old Tomás. Its dam holds back half the river.
celestial-invader.097: “Break my dam? It is my life!” “And Toletum is the life of us all.”
celestial-invader.098: Tomás looks at the smoke over Toletum... and he agrees.
celestial-invader.099: Above, half a river held back. Below, the dry riverbed.
celestial-invader.100: The trap is a fat cow at the foot of the dam.
celestial-invader.101: “I am sorry, my friend. I promise you will come out of this.”
celestial-invader.102: They rub her with honey so the smell carries far.
celestial-invader.107: They wait in hiding beside the posts of the dam.
celestial-invader.108: The cow sees her end coming.
celestial-invader.109: The dragon comes down for her.
celestial-invader.113: SPLAAASH! Half the Tajo falls on it.
celestial-invader.114: SSSSSSHHHHH! The water burns its scales.
celestial-invader.118: It looks for the man who has tricked it.
celestial-invader.119: “HERAN... CLEVER! DRAGON COME BACK... AND HERAN PAY!”
celestial-invader.120: Toletum is safe... for now. TO BE CONTINUED...
